so tasmiṃ ambavane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭhāna-leṇakuṭi-maṇḍap'ādīni sampādetvā bhagavato anucchavikaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ kārāpetvā ambavanaṃ aṭṭhārasahatth'ubbedhena tambapaṭṭavaṇṇena pākārena parikkhipāpetvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sacīvarabhattena santappetvā dakkhiṇ'odakaṃ pātetvā vihāraṃ niyyātesi.

74153.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of chanda
74153.commentary: (KVa) chandaso'ti methunarāgappaṭisaṃyuttena chandena c'eva ruciyā ca. chande pana asati balakkārena padhaṃsitāya anāpatti, tasmā yā paripuṇṇūpasampadā bhikkhunī manuss'āmanussa-tiracchāna-jātīsu purisa-ubhatobyañjanaka-paṇḍakānaṃ yassa kassaci sajīvassa vā nijjīvassa vā santhatassa vā asanthatassa vā akkhāyitassa vā yebhuyyena akkhāyitassa vā aṅgajātassa attano vaccamaggapassāvamaggamukhesu tīsu yatthakatthaci santhate vā asanthate vā pakativātena asaṃphuṭṭhe allokāse antamaso tilaphalamattam'pi padesaṃ chandaso paveseti, parena vā pavesiyamānā pavesana-paviṭṭha-ṭṭhita-uddharaṇesu yaṃkiñci sādiyati, ayaṃ pārājikā hoti. sesam'ettha ito paresu ca sādhāraṇasikkhāpadesu vuttanayānusāreneva veditabbaṃ.

74154.meaning1: frivolous talk; foolish chatter; useless speech

examples.text: kacci musā na bhaṇati, kacci na khīṇabyappatho, kacci vebhūtiyaṃ n'āha, kacci samphaṃ na bhāsati.
yo uddhatena cittena, samphañ'ca bahu bhāsati, asamāhitasaṅkappo, asaddhammarato mago, ārā so thāvareyyamhā, pāpadiṭṭhi anādaro.

74156.commentary: (DNa) pābhataṃ anuppadetū'ti sakkhiṃ akatvā paṇṇe anāropetvā mūlacchejjavasena bhaṇḍamūlaṃ detū'ti attho. bhaṇḍamūlassa hi pābhatan'ti nāmaṃ.

examples.text: ye ca rañño janapade ussahiṃsu vāṇijjāya, tesaṃ rājā mahāvijito pābhataṃ anuppadāsi. ye ca rañño janapade ussahiṃsu rājaporise, tesaṃ rājā mahāvijito bhattavetanaṃ pakappesi.

74157.grammar: adj, in comps, from yojeti, caus (+loc)
74157.commentary: (SNa) yācayogo'ti parehi yācitabb'āraho, yācayogo'ti vā yācayogen'eva yutto. (ANa) yācayogo'ti yācituṃ yutto, yācakehi vā yogo assā'ti'pi yācayogo.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti, ime pana jhāyino'mhā, jhāyino'mhā'ti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti avajjhāyanti. kim'ime jhāyanti, kint'ime jhāyanti, kathaṃ ime jhāyantī'ti?
yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyaṃ muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato

74161.meaning1: lazybones; who is slack; inactive person
74161.commentary: (SNa) dukkhaṃ, bhikkhave, kusīto viharatī'ti imasmiṃ sāsane yo kusīto puggalo, so dukkhaṃ viharati. bāhirasamaye pana yo kusīto, so sukhaṃ viharati.

examples.text: dukkhaṃ, bhikkhave, kusīto viharati vokiṇṇo pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi, mahantañ'ca sadatthaṃ parihāpeti. āraddhavīriyo ca kho, bhikkhave, sukhaṃ viharati pavivitto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi, mahantañ'ca sadatthaṃ paripūreti.

74162.meaning1: energetic person; who applies oneself; who makes an effort
74162.commentary: (SNa) āraddhavīriyo ca kho, bhikkhave'ti āraddhavīriyo puggalo imasmiṃ'y'eva sāsane sukhaṃ viharati. bāhirasamaye pana yo āraddhavīriyo, so dukkhaṃ viharati.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo ca kho, bhikkhave, sukhaṃ viharati pavivitto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi, mahantañ'ca sadatthaṃ paripūreti. na, bhikkhave, hīnena aggassa patti hoti.
tikkhattuṃ akkulo pakkulo'ti akkulapakkulikaṃ akāsī'ti tayo vāre akkulo pakkulo'ti bhiṃsāpetu'kāmatāya evarūpaṃ saddaṃ akāsi. anukaraṇasaddo hi ayaṃ.

te ca brāhmaṇiyonijā'va samānā evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.

74167.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of āyāma

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa ayaṃ kusinārā kusāvatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi, puratthimena ca pacchimena ca dvādasayojanāni āyāmena, uttarena ca dakkhiṇena ca sattayojanāni vitthārena.

74169.commentary: (DHPa) kammavisuddhin'ti dhammika-upāsako'pi attano kammavisuddhiṃ puññakammasampattiṃ disvā kālakiriyato pubbe idhaloke'pi modati, kālaṃ katvā idāni paraloke'pi atimodati'y'evā'ti.

examples.text: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.

74170.commentary: (DHPa) disvā kammakiliṭṭhan'ti attano kiliṭṭhakammaṃ passitvā nānappakārakaṃ vilapanto vihaññatī'ti.

examples.text: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.

74171.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of dhātu
74171.meaning1: according to disposition; as per character
74171.commentary: (ITIa) dhātuso'ti dhātuto. dhātū'ti ca ajjhāsayadhātu ajjhāsayasabhāvo adhippeto, yo adhimuttī'ti'pi vuccati.

examples.text: dhātuso'va, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.

74176.meaning1: not mentioned; not written; not appeared

74177.synonym: adesayi, desayi, desesi, nidaṃsesi, pakāsesi, pavedesi
74177.commentary: (NIDD2) dhammam'adesesī'ti.… ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānīakāsi pakāsesī'ti, yo me dhammam'adesesi.

examples.text: buddho dhammam'adesesi, jātiyā samatikkamaṃ, sabbadukkhappahānāya, so maṃ sacce nivesayi.

74178.meaning1: seven days of inclement weather; weeklong rainfall

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena mahā akālamegho udapādi satt'āhavaddalikā sītavātaduddinī. atha kho mucalindo nāgarājā sakabhavanā nikkhamitvā bhagavato kāyaṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā uparimuddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ vihacca aṭṭhāsi

seyyathā'pi, bhante, paluṭṭhamakkaṭī kaṇṇanāsacchinnā, evam'eva kho, bhante, sākiyānī janapadakalyāṇī imesaṃ pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhyam'pi n'opeti kalabhāgam'pi n'opeti upanidhim'pi n'opeti.

74180.meaning1: the word 'hired worker'; the phrase 'wage labourer'
74180.commentary: (UDa) bhatakavādenā'ti bhatako'ti vādena. yo hi bhatiyā kammaṃ karoti, so bhatako'ti vuccati, ayam'pi āyasmā accharāsambhoganimittaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranto bhatako viya hotī'ti vuttaṃ bhatakavādenā'ti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato nandassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca samudācaranti, bhatako kir'āyasmā nando upakkitako kir'āyasmā nando accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhagavā kir'assa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānan'ti.

74181.meaning1: the word 'bought man'; the term 'purchased'; (comm) the word 'buyer'
74181.commentary: (UDa) upakkitakavādenā'ti yo kahāpaṇ'ādīhi kiñci kiṇāti, so upakkitako'ti vuccati, ayam'pi āyasmā accharānaṃ hetu attano brahmacariyaṃ kiṇāti, tasmā upakkitako'ti evaṃ vacanena. atha vā bhagavato āṇāya accharāsambhogasaṅkhātāya bhatiyā brahmacariyavāsasaṅkhātaṃ jīvitaṃ pavattento tāya bhatiyā yāpane bhagavatā bhariyamāno viya hotī'ti bhatako'ti vutto, tathā accharāsambhogasaṅkhātaṃ vikkayaṃ ādātabbaṃ katvā bhagavato āṇattiyaṃ tiṭṭhanto tena vikkayena bhagavatā upakkito viya hotī'ti vuttaṃ upakkitako'ti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato nandassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bhatakavādena ca upakkitakavādena ca samudācaranti, bhatako kir'āyasmā nando upakkitako kir'āyasmā nando accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhagavā kir'assa pāṭibhogo pañcannaṃ accharāsatānaṃ paṭilābhāya kakuṭapādānan'ti.

74182.meaning1: thorn of lust; prick of sensual desire
74182.commentary: (UDa) maddito kāmakaṇḍako'ti yena sattānaṃ vijjhanato. kāmakaṇḍako'ti laddhanāmo sabbo kilesakāmo sabbo kāmavisūko aggañāṇadaṇḍena maddito bhaggo anavasesato mathito.

examples.text: yassa nittiṇṇo paṅko, maddito kāmakaṇṭako, mohakkhayaṃ anuppatto, sukhadukkhesu na vedhatī sa bhikkhū'ti.

74183.meaning1: led by Yasoja; headed by Yasoja
74183.commentary: (UDa) tatiye yasojappamukhānī'ti ettha yasojo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ, taṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ katvā pabbajitattā vicaraṇato ca tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni yasojappamukhānī'ti vuttāni.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena yasojappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.

74184.commentary: (UDa) yasojappamukhānī'ti ettha yasojo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ, taṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ katvā pabbajitattā vicaraṇato ca tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni yasojappamukhānī'ti vuttāni.
74184.notes: Theragāthā verses 243-245 (TH3.9, TH178) are attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena yasojappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.

74185.grammar: abs of caus of pati saṃ √sam, caus, trans (+acc)
74185.meaning1: having neatly arranged; having set in order

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā sen'āsanaṃ paṭisaṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya yena vajjī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu.

74186.commentary: (UDa) ālokajātā viyā'ti sañjātālokā viya. itaraṃ tass'eva vevacanaṃ, candasahassasūriyasahassehi obhāsitā viyā'ti attho. yasmā te yasojappamukhā pañcasatā bhikkhū sabbaso avijjandhakāravidhamanena ālokabhūtā obhāsabhūtā hutvā viharanti, tasmā bhagavā tehi ṭhitadisāya ālokajātā viya me, ānanda, esā disā'ti-ādinā vaṇṇabhaṇanāpadesena te bhikkhū pasaṃsati. (VISMa) ālokajātan'ti ālokabhūtaṃ, jātālokaṃ vā.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasi karitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, ālokajātā viya me, ānanda, esā disā, obhāsajātā viya me, ānanda, esā disā, yassaṃ disāyaṃ vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū viharanti.

74187.meaning1: imperturbable stability of mind; perfectly stable mental stillness
74187.commentary: (UDa) āneñjasamādhinā'ti catutthajjhānapādakena aggaphalasamādhinā, arūpajjhānapādakenā'ti'pi vadanti. āneñjena samādhinā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, āneñjena kho bhagavā vihārena eta'r'ahi viharatī'ti. sabb'eva āneñjasamādhinā nisīdiṃsu.

74188.commentary: (UDa) vasalavādena samudācaratī'ti ehi, vasala, apehi, vasalā'ti-ādinā bhikkhū vasalavādena voharati ālapati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā pilindavaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarati.

74189.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ya, irreg form of yamhi
74189.meaning1: in whoever; in whom; in which

examples.text: yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

74190.meaning1: who has dispelled anger; who has removed rage
74190.commentary: (UDa) panuṇṇakodho'ti kujjhanalakkhaṇassa kodhassa anāgāmimaggena sabbaso pahīnattā panuṇṇakodho samucchinn'āghāto.

examples.text: yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

74191.meaning1: appearance of an embroiderer; guise of a weaver

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sakko devānam'indo āyasmato mahākassapassa piṇḍapātaṃ dātu'kāmo hoti. pesakāravaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā tantaṃ vinā'ti. sujā asurakaññā tasaraṃ pūreti.

74192.meaning1: consisting of many tasty curries; (or) curries with many different flavours
74192.commentary: (UDa) anekarasabyañjano'ti anekehi sūpehi c'eva byañjanehi ca madhur'ādi-mūla-rasānañ'c'eva sambhinnarasānañ'ca abhibyañjako, nān'aggarasa-sūpabyañjano'ti attho.

examples.text: so ahosi piṇḍapāto anekasūpo anekabyañjano anekarasabyañjano. atha kho āyasmato mahākassapassa etadahosi, ko nu kho ayaṃ satto yass'āyaṃ evarūpo iddh'ānubhāvo'ti?

74193.commentary: (UDa) aho dānan'ti vatvā tassa dānassa vuttanayena uttamadānabhāvaṃ khettaṅ'gatabhāvañ'ca pakāsento paramadānaṃ kassape suppatiṭṭhitan'ti udānaṃ udānesi.

examples.text: aho dānaṃ paramadānaṃ kassape suppatiṭṭhitaṃ! aho dānaṃ paramadānaṃ kassape suppatiṭṭhitaṃ!!

piṇḍapātiko, āvuso, bhikkhu piṇḍāya caranto labhati kālena kālaṃ manāpike cakkhunā rūpe passituṃ, labhati kālena kālaṃ manāpike sotena sadde sotuṃ, labhati kālena kālaṃ manāpike ghānena gandhe ghāyituṃ
mayam'pi lacchāma kālena kālaṃ manāpike ghānena gandhe ghāyituṃ, mayam'pi lacchāma kālena kālaṃ manāpike jivhāya rase sāyituṃ, mayam'pi lacchāma kālena kālaṃ manāpike kāyena phoṭṭhabbe phusituṃ

74196.meaning1: to be praised; to be spoken of highly (by)

74197.commentary: (UDa) no ce saddasilokanissito'ti aho ayyo app'iccho santuṭṭho parama-sallekhavuttī'ti-ādinā parehi kittitabbasaddasaṅkhātaṃ silokaṃ. taṇhāya nissito na hoti ce'ti attho. saddo vā sammukhā vaṇṇabhaṇanathutighoso, siloko parammukhabhūtā pasaṃsā patthaṭayasatā vā. sesaṃ anantarasutte vuttanayam'eva.

examples.text: piṇḍapātikassa bhikkhuno, attabharassa anaññaposino, devā pihayanti tādino, no ce saddasilokanissito'ti.

74198.meaning1: fact of being famous; good repute

74199.commentary: (UDa) hatthisippan'ti yaṃ hatthīnaṃ pariggaṇhana-damana-sāraṇa-rogatikicch'ādi-bhedaṃ kattabbaṃ, taṃ uddissa pavattaṃ sabbam'pi sippaṃ idha hatthisippan'ti adhippetaṃ. assasippan'ti etthā'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tatth'ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, hatthisippaṃ sippānaṃ aggan'ti. ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, assasippaṃ sippānaṃ aggan'ti. ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, rathasippaṃ sippānaṃ aggan'ti.
